newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares climb as banks report profits.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares climb as banks report profits.

text.p: Estonian shares were bullish on Wednesday as the market took heart from a good crop of January profit figures from leading commercial banks, dealers said.
"The bank sector dominated trade with their good results and made the market bullish, perhaps too bullish," said one dealer.
The Tallinn stock index gained 2.23 percent to close at 191.92 on trade of 67 million kroons on the official list.
Leading blue chip Hansapank surged 5.50 kroons to close at 182.00 kroons with on healthy turnover of 19.5 million kroons after it reported a January profit of 52 million kroons.
But one dealer noted that the January figure was boosted by some one-off items such as the sale of its stake in second-largest bank Savings Bank.
Forkespank also made a strong showing on turnover of 14.8 million kroons to close up 2.95 kroons on 153.00 kroons.
Savings Bank gained 2.70 kroons to finish at 93.70 kroons with 12.6 million kroons worth of stock changing hands.
Union Bank was actively traded and firmed to close up 0.40 kroons on 39.35 kroons after turning over 11.8 million kroons.
On the over-the-counter market turnover was strong at 10.8 million kroons but stocks were mixed.
Rakvere meat plant was the most traded with 3.9 million kroons of stocks traded to close unchanged at 15.65 kroons.
Norma plastics manufacturer saw 2.7 million kroons of trade to close 0.10 kroons lower at 57.90.
